plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for COMET SYSTEM WebSensor temperature / humidity transmitters (T3510-MIB, enterprise PEN 22626). It reports uptime, temperature, relative humidity, temperature and humidity alarms, and interface traffic.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Temperature measured by the COMET WebSensor in degrees Celsius, from tempInt (T3510-MIB, 1.3.6.1.4.1.22626.1.2.3.1.0, value x10, divided by 10). Readings are converted when the device temperature unit (tempUnit 1.3.6.1.4.1.22626.1.2.1.9.0) is Fahrenheit; out-of-range values are dropped.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Relative humidity measured by the COMET WebSensor in percent, from humInt (1.3.6.1.4.1.22626.1.2.3.2.0, value x10, divided by 10). Values outside 0-100 (for example on temperature-only models) are dropped.

metrics.name: env_temperature_state
metrics.description: Temperature alarm from tempAlarmInt (1.3.6.1.4.1.22626.1.2.3.5.0): no alarm maps to 1, high or low alarm maps to 2. Only reported together with a valid temperature reading.

metrics.name: env_humidity_state
metrics.description: Relative humidity alarm from humAlarmInt (1.3.6.1.4.1.22626.1.2.3.6.0): no alarm maps to 1, high or low alarm maps to 2. Only reported together with a valid humidity reading.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
